$comment: Machine contract for any AI adding a language or concept. Follow this file; do not invent verified cells.
invariant: verified means a human-checkable mechanism. unknown stays unverified. empowers is prose, never an edge.

steps: 1. Append one object to corpus/catalog/languages.json with a unique id (kebab, ascii).
2. Set family, runtimeKind, so2025_pct (number or null), jobRelevant: true, aliases (every spelling you might see in jobs or docs).
3. Set clusterDefault for paradigms, types, memory, concurrency: unverified | absent_by_design.
4. If runtimeKind is markup, stylesheet, query, or hardware, write absentReason.
5. Add authored cells only where you can fill mechanism, why, useWhen, price from a real spec/runtime. Path: corpus/authored/cells/<langId>/<conceptId>.json
1. Add a node id prog_<cluster>_<slug> to app/public/data/programming_tower.json (or the authored PROG dict) with isLayer false and layerId in {paradigms, types, memory, concurrency, ...}.
2. Author the concept record with EVERY key in templateConcept. empowered_by is required and must be checkable.
3. Put language cells under corpus/authored/cells/<langId>/<conceptId>.json — one file per pair. Do not pack 20 languages into one prose blob.
4. inheritsFrom / specializesInto are taxonomy only. uses/how/forCase live in empowered_by.
5. Never emit an edge from empowers; store it as empowers prose.

forbidden: Marking coverage verified with empty mechanism
Copying another language's cell and changing the name
Combining languages in one lang field (no 'Java / Go')

templateCell.useWhen: The case this is the right tool.
templateCell.source: Primary spec or runtime docs URL/title

cli.newLanguage: python3 corpus/authored/extend.py new-language --id foo --label Foo --family systems --kind general
cli.newConcept: python3 corpus/authored/extend.py new-concept --id prog_types_example --layer types --label Example
